title: Rabbi Chanin son of Rabbi
author: Aharon Hyman

paragraphs: So it is cited in Vayikra Rabbah, beginning of chapter 22: “Rabbi Yishmael son of Rabbi Tanchum and Rabbi Chanin son of Rabbi, in the name of Rabbi Yirmeyah: It is written, ‘And they shall come down from their ships.’” Hyman calls this a scribal error and proposes as in Shir HaShirim Rabbah 7:1: “Rabbi Shmuel bar Tanchum and Rabbi Chanan son of Rabbi Berekhyah of Botzrah in the name of Rabbi Yirmeyah.” The Yalkut, Kohelet, chapter 5, on the verse “And the advantage,” copied: “Rabbi Yishmael bar Tanchum and Rabbi Natan son of Rabbi Berekhyah in the name of Rabbi Yirmeyah.”

notes.text: The supplied ויק״ד is read as Vayikra Rabbah and ב״ת as bar Tanchum. Hyman’s proposed corrections preserve the Yishmael/Shmuel and Chanin/Chanan/Natan variants; no harmonized chain replaces them.

The consulted Vayikra Rabbah 22:1 has Yishmael son of Rabbi Tanchum and Chanin son of Rabbi; the consulted Shir HaShirim Rabbah 7:1 has Shmuel bar Tanchum and Chanan son of Rabbi Berekhyah of Botzrah. These parallel chains are retained distinctly. Hyman’s reported Yalkut Natan reading was not independently inspected in that exact witness.
